footprints.description: 2-pad SMD crystal, 1.2 x 1.0 mm body, ECS ECX-1210

footprints.description: 2-pad SMD crystal, 1.27 x 1.05 mm body, Suntsu SWS102
footprints.note: Suntsu SWS102 outline and recommended land pattern (datasheets/crystal/suntsu/SWS102-Series.pdf p.1). footprints.description: 2-pad SMD crystal, 1.6 x 1.0 mm body, Abracon ABS05 land pattern

footprints.description: 2-pad SMD crystal, 2.5 x 2.0 mm body, Abracon ABM10A

Body 2.50 x 2.00. No pad numbers in the drawing; pad 1 left.

footprints.description: 2-pad SMD crystal, 3.2 x 1.5 mm body, Abracon ABS07 land pattern
footprints.note: Abracon ABS07 recommended land pattern (datasheets/crystal/abracon/ABS07.pdf p.4): pad 0.043 in = 1.1 wide x 0.075 in = 1.9 high, gap 0.055 in = 1.4 -> span 1.1 + 1.4 = 2.5. Body 3.2 x 1.5. Pad 1 left (ABS07 drawing marks the chamfered terminal).

footprints.description: 2-pad SMD crystal, 3.2 x 1.5 mm body, Suntsu SAW312
footprints.note: Suntsu SAW312 recommended land pattern (datasheets/crystal/suntsu/SAW312-Series.pdf p.1). Drawing is portrait: pad 1.80 x 1.00, gap 1.50 -> centre distance 1.00 + 1.50 = 2.50. Turned 90 degrees: pad 1.00 wide x 1.80 high, span 2.5. Body 1.50 x 3.20 turned to 3.2 x 1.5. No pad numbers in the drawing; pad 1 left.

footprints.description: 3-pad SMD crystal, 3.2 x 1.5 mm body, ECS ECX-34G (case ground pad 2)
footprints.note: ECS ECX-34G Figure 2 suggested land (datasheets/crystal/ecs/ECX-34G.pdf p.1): two pads 1.3 x 0.75 with 0.4 between them, one pad 1.3 x 1.9 (0.75 + 0.4 + 0.75), gap 1.0 between the columns -> column centres +-(1.0 + 1.3) / 2 = +-1.15, small pad centres +-(0.4 + 0.75) / 2 = +-0.575. Pad connections: 1 In/Out, 2 Gnd or NC (the large pad), 3 Out/In. The land pattern carries no numbers; the bottom view has #1 top left, #3 bottom left, #2 right, so the top view mirrors it (#1 top right, #3 bottom right, #2 left) and turned 180 degrees gives the small pads on the left as drawn, #1 bottom left, #3 top left, #2 the large pad on the right (1 and 3 are interchangeable). Body 3.2 x 1.5.

footprints.description: 2-pad SMD crystal, 3.2 x 2.5 mm body, Abracon ABM8A

ECS ECX-33AQ Figure 2 (ECX-33AQ.pdf p.1: 1.5 x 2.7, 1.9 centre to centre) is the same. Body 3.20 x 2.50. Pad 1 left.

footprints.description: 2-pad SMD crystal, 5.0 x 3.2 mm body, Abracon ABM3

footprints.description: 2-pad SMD crystal, 6.0 x 3.5 mm body, Abracon ABM7

footprints.description: 2-pad SMD crystal, 8.0 x 4.5 mm body, Abracon ABM2

footprints.description: 4-pad SMD crystal, 1.0 x 0.8 mm body, 0.35 x 0.40 mm pads (Abracon ABM14)
footprints.note: Abracon ABM14 "Recommended Land Pattern" (datasheets/crystal/abracon/ABM14.pdf p.3): pads 0.40 x 0.35, gap 0.30 between pad columns, gap 0.20 between pad rows (dimension "0.30" is the gap, "4X 0.40" the pad width, "4X 0.35" the pad height; cross-checked against the 1.0 x 0.8 body outline). Centres: x = +-(0.30/2+0.40/2) = +-0.35, y = +-(0.20/2+0.35/2) = +-0.275. Datasheet land pattern is drawn in the part's top-view orientation (pad 1 bottom-left); turned 90 degrees clockwise so pad 1 is top-left (dual numbering): datasheet pad width/height swap, datasheet x-centre distance becomes the pitch and y-centre distance the span. Result: span 2 x 0.275 = 0.55, pitch 2 x 0.35 = 0.70, pad 0.35 x 0.40. Same-series ABM14N (ABM14N.pdf p.3) draws 0.42 x 0.33 pads, gaps 0.21 / 0.19 (not equal; this footprint is the ABM14 drawing). Hand check: pad centres recomputed from the printed dimensions above and matched to span / pitch / pad size.

footprints.description: 4-pad SMD crystal, 11.8 x 5.5 mm body, 2.3 x 2.4 mm pads (Abracon ABC2)
footprints.note: Abracon ABC2 "Recommended Land Pattern" (datasheets/crystal/abracon/ABC2.pdf p.5): pads 2.4 wide x 2.3 tall, gap 2.68 between pad columns (5.08 pitch = 2.4 + 2.68, equal to the 5.08 terminal pitch), 2.1 between pad rows. Centres x = +-(2.68/2+2.4/2) = +-2.54, y = +-(2.1/2+2.3/2) = +-2.2. The drawing is not to scale horizontally. Datasheet land pattern is drawn in the part's top-view orientation (pad 1 bottom-left); turned 90 degrees clockwise so pad 1 is top-left (dual numbering): datasheet pad width/height swap, datasheet x-centre distance becomes the pitch and y-centre distance the span. Result: span 2 x 2.2 = 4.4, pitch 2 x 2.54 = 5.08, pad 2.3 x 2.4. Pads 1,2 are the two adjacent pads on one long side (pinout 1=X1,2=X2). Hand check: pad centres recomputed from the printed dimensions above and matched to span / pitch / pad size.

footprints.note: datasheets/crystal/ecs/ecx-32.pdf p.1 Figure 2 Suggested land: pads 1.3 x 1.1 (width x height) with 1.0 / 0.7 gaps, so centres 1.0 + 1.3 = 2.3 horizontally (printed 2.3) and 0.7 + 1.1 = 1.8 vertically (printed 1.8); same in ECX-33Q.pdf and ECX-33B2Q.pdf p.1; body 3.2 x 2.5 (+/-0.1) from Figure 1; drawn upright: turned 90 deg clockwise so pin 1 (bottom-left in the top view) sits at the top of the left column (datasheet pad width/height become height/width, the horizontal centre distance becomes the pitch, the vertical one the span). ECS-33B.pdf, ECS-33B2.pdf, ECX-33QZ.pdf p.1 draw 1.3 x 1.1 pads at 2.3 x 1.9 (vertical centre 1.9), not used; ECS-122.8-CDX-0921.pdf prints no land pattern (package type ECX-32)

footprints.description: 4-pad SMD crystal, 3.2 x 2.5 mm ceramic (Suntsu SXT324)

SAX324-Series.pdf p.1 draws 1.05 x 1.3 pads at 1.85 x 2.30, not used

footprints.description: 4-pad SMD crystal, 6.0 x 3.5 mm ceramic (Abracon ABMM2)
footprints.note: datasheets/crystal/abracon/ABMM2.pdf p.3 Recommended Land Pattern: pads 1.95 x 1.40 (width x height; 4X 1.95, 4X 1.40), gaps 2.40 horizontally and 1.10 vertically between pad edges, so centres 2.40 + 1.95 = 4.35 and 1.10 + 1.40 = 2.50; body 6.00 x 3.50 (+/-0.20) from Top View (DigiKey calls it 6x3.6); pads numbered 4 3 / 1 2 in the Circuit (top) view; drawn upright: turned 90 deg clockwise so pin 1 (bottom-left in the top view) sits at the top of the left column (datasheet pad width/height become height/width, the horizontal centre distance becomes the pitch, the vertical one the span)

footprints.description: 4-pad SMD crystal, 6.9 x 1.4 mm plastic flat-lead package (Abracon ABS13, ECS ECX-71)
footprints.note: datasheets/crystal/abracon/ABS13.pdf p.2 Recommended Land Pattern: four pads 1.2 x 0.6 (width x height), 5.1 between the end pads so centres 5.1 + 1.2 = 6.3 horizontally, 0.3 gap between the stacked pads so centres 0.3 + 0.6 = 0.9 vertically; body 6.9 x 1.4 (D, E of the Dimension Table); the land pattern is not numbered: pads taken as the outline's 4# 3# / 1# 2# top-view numbering (1, 4 the crystal terminals at the left end); drawn upright: turned 90 deg clockwise so pin 1 (bottom-left in the top view) sits at the top of the left column (datasheet pad width/height become height/width, the horizontal centre distance becomes the pitch, the vertical one the span); ecs/ecx-71.pdf p.1 Figure 2 draws the same pads (1.2 x 0.6, 5.1, 0.3) with body 7.0 x 1.5 max, so ECX-71 shares this id

footprints.description: 4-pad SMD crystal, 7.2 x 5.2 mm max ceramic (Abracon ABMM)
footprints.note: datasheets/crystal/abracon/ABMM.pdf p.2 Recommended Land Pattern: pad-centre distance 6.3 horizontally, 2.54 vertically; pads 2.2 x 1.4 (width x height) and one longer pad 2.4 x 1.4 on the bottom-right (top view = pad 4, the 1.5 mm terminal of the bottom view) whose outer edge lines up with the others (centre 3.15 - 0.1 = 3.05, width 2.4); body 7.2 x 5.2 (printed max). Top view numbers 1 bottom-left, 2 top-left, 3 top-right, 4 bottom-right (clockwise, unlike the other crystals), so explicit pads; drawn upright: turned 90 deg clockwise (x, y) -> (-y, x): pad 1 (-3.15, 1.27) -> (-1.27, -3.15), 2 (-3.15, -1.27) -> (1.27, -3.15), 3 (3.15, -1.27) -> (1.27, 3.15), 4 (outer-edge-aligned 2.4 pad, centre (3.05, 1.27)) -> (-1.27, 3.05). Note 1 says the long pad may be on pad 2, 3 or 4 of the part; the drawn pattern is used as printed

footprints.description: 4-pad SMD crystal, 7.0 x 5.0 mm ceramic (ECS CSM-8Q, CSM-8M)
footprints.note: datasheets/crystal/ecs/CSM-8Q.pdf p.1 Figure 2 Suggested land: pads 2.0 x 1.4 (width x height), pad-centre distance 6.0 horizontally and 2.54 vertically; same in csm-8mr.pdf p.1; body 7.0 x 5.0 (+/-0.5 / +/-0.2) from Figure 1; top-view numbering #4 #3 / #1 #2; drawn upright: turned 90 deg clockwise so pin 1 (bottom-left in the top view) sits at the top of the left column (datasheet pad width/height become height/width, the horizontal centre distance becomes the pitch, the vertical one the span)

footprints.description: Abracon AB26TRQ 32.768 kHz cylindrical crystal, 5.2 x 1.45 mm can with two formed leads, plus a body pad
footprints.note: AB26TRQ.pdf p.2 Recommended Land Pattern (mm). Origin = centre of the 5.2 x 1.45 can; can's left end = left edge of the body pad. Body pad 2.4 x 1.5 (unnumbered, pin 0, not a terminal), gap 3.8, lead pads 1.1 x 0.6 (0.6 + 0.3 gap + 0.6 = 1.5 tall). Arithmetic (land x from the left edge of the body pad; origin at 2.6): body pad centre 2.4/2 = 1.2 -> x -1.4; lead pads start 2.4 + 3.8 = 6.2, end 6.2 + 1.1 = 7.3, centre 6.75 -> x 4.15 (lead tip 5.2 + 1.5 = 6.7 sits at the pad centre); lead pad y centres +-(0.3/2 + 0.6/2) = +-0.45. Pad 1 top, pad 2 bottom (datasheet does not number them; crystal has no polarity).

footprints.description: Abracon AB26TRB 32.768 kHz cylindrical crystal, 6.0 x 1.9 mm can with two formed leads, plus a body pad
footprints.note: AB26TRB.pdf p.2 Outline Dimensions table F G H J K M (mm; the can is not to be soldered, glue it down). Body pad F x G = 2.5 x 2.5 (unnumbered, pin 0), H = 5.25 from its right edge to the lead pads, lead pads J x K = 2.5 x 1.0, gap between lead pads M = 1.5 (c-c 1.5 + 1.0 = 2.5, matches lead spacing D 2.54). Arithmetic (land x from the body pad's left edge): lead pads start 2.5 + 5.25 = 7.75, end 10.25, centre 9.0; body pad centre 1.25. Body (6.0 long) placed so the lead tip (body end + 2.0) is at the lead pad centre: body x 1.0..7.0, centre 4.0 -> body pad x -2.75, lead pads x 5.0; lead pad y centres +-(1.5/2 + 1.0/2) = +-1.25. Pad 1 top, pad 2 bottom (unnumbered in the datasheet).

footprints.description: HC-49/US surface-mount crystal, 11.4 x 4.7 mm, 2 tab pads, Abracon land pattern 5.6 x 2.1 at 9.5
footprints.note: Abracon ABLS3.pdf p.3 Recommended land pattern (also ABLS2.pdf p.3, ABLS.pdf p.3, ABLS-LR.pdf p.2: same drawing): pad 0.22 in (5.6) x 0.083 in (2.1), centre distance 0.374 in (9.5). Hand check: span 9.5 -> pad centres +-4.75; inner pad edges 4.75 - 2.8 = +-1.95 (gap 3.9), outer edges +-7.55 (overall 15.1).

footprints.description: ECS CSM-3X miniature HC-49/US surface-mount crystal, 7.0 x 4.1 mm, 2 tab pads 3.5 x 1.2 at 5.5
footprints.note: ECS CSM-3X.pdf p.1 Figure 2 Suggested land: overall 9.0, left pad width 3.5, gap 2.0, right pad 3.5, height 1.2 (the 2.0 dimension sits between the pads, the 3.5 under the right pad). Hand check: 3.5 + 2.0 + 3.5 = 9.0; centres +-(2.0/2 + 3.5/2) = +-2.75 -> span 5.5.

footprints.description: ECS CSM-7X / 7SSX / 7XDU / 7XDN HC-49/US surface-mount crystal, 11.4 x 4.8 mm, 2 tab pads 5.5 x 2.0 at 9.5
footprints.note: ECS csm-7x-dn.pdf p.1 Figure 2 Suggested land (CSM-7X, CSM-7SSX, CSM_7X_DU, csm-7x-dn: same figure): overall 15.0, gap 4.0, pad 5.5, height 2.0. Also the Suntsu SXTHM2 land pattern (pad 5.5 x 2.0, c-c 9.5). Hand check: 5.5 + 4.0 + 5.5 = 15.0; centres +-(4.0/2 + 5.5/2) = +-4.75 -> span 9.5.

footprints.description: HC-49/US surface-mount crystal, 11.4 x 4.7 mm, 3 pads (case-grounded third lead), Abracon ABLSG land pattern
footprints.note: Abracon ABLSG.pdf p.2 Recommended land pattern: outer pads 5.6 x 2.1 at 9.5 c-c, middle (GND) pad 2.1 wide x 4.0 tall, its top level with the outer pads' tops. Hand check: outer pad centres x +-4.75, y 0 (tabs leave the case at mid height); outer pad y -1.05..1.05; middle pad y -1.05..2.95 (top -1.05 + 4.0 = 2.95), centre y 0.95, centre x 0, width 2.1 -> gap to outer pads (9.5 - 5.6 - 2.1)/2 = 0.9. Datasheet does not number the leads (Input/Output left, GND bottom): 1 left, 2 GND bottom, 3 right as in the pinout.

footprints.description: ECS CSM-7X-3L HC-49/US surface-mount crystal, 11.4 x 4.7 mm, 3 pads (case-grounded third lead)
footprints.note: ECS csm_7x_3l.pdf p.1 Figure 2 Suggested land: outer pads 5.0 x 1.5, gap between them 4.0, middle pad 4.0 tall (top level with the outer pads), middle pad width not printed (1.8 scaled from the drawing, 0.46 of the 4.0 gap). Pad numbers from the Top View (#1 left, #2 right, #3 bottom/Gnd). Hand check: outer centres x +-(4.0/2 + 5.0/2) = +-4.5, y 0, overall 5.0 + 4.0 + 5.0 = 14.0; middle pad y -0.75..3.25 (top -0.75 + 4.0), centre y 1.25, x 0.

footprints.description: HC-49/US surface-mount crystal, 12.5 x 4.95 mm, 4 pads 3.0 x 2.5, Abracon ABSM3A land pattern
footprints.note: Abracon ABSM3A.pdf p.3 Recommended land pattern: pads 0.12 in (3.0) wide x 0.10 in (2.5) tall, 0.36 in (9.0) apart in x and 0.13 in (3.2) apart in y (both dimensions run between pad centre lines; outline lead spacing 9.0 +-0.1). Pad numbers #1 BL, #2 BR, #3 TR, #4 TL (top view). Hand check: x +-9.0/2 = +-4.5; y +-3.2/2 = +-1.6 (pad y edges +-0.35..+-2.85, 0.375 past the 4.95 body edge).

footprints.description: ECS CSM-4AX HC-49/US surface-mount crystal, 12.5 x 4.85 mm, 4 pads 2.3 x 2.2
footprints.note: ECS csm-4ax.pdf p.1 Figure 2 Suggested land: pads 2.3 wide x 2.2 tall, 9.0 apart in x and 3.5 apart in y (between pad centre lines, as the 9.0 lead spacing in Figure 1). Numbers from Figure 1 top view: 1 BL, 2 BR, 3 TR, 4 TL. Hand check: x +-9.0/2 = +-4.5; y +-3.5/2 = +-1.75 (pad y edges +-0.65..+-2.85).

footprints.description: 4-pad SOJ-style 32.768 kHz crystal, 8.0 x 3.8 mm, pads 1.3 x 1.9 on a 5.5 x 3.2 rectangle
footprints.note: Abracon abs25.pdf p.2 Recommended Land Pattern (also ECS ecx-306x.pdf p.1 Figure 2, same pads and numbering): pad 0.05 in (1.3) wide x 0.075 in (1.9) tall; x chain 1.3 | 4.2 | 1.3, y chain 1.9 | 1.3 | 1.9 (edge to edge). Numbers #1 BL, #2 BR, #3 TR, #4 TL (top view). Hand check: x centres +-(4.2/2 + 1.3/2) = +-2.75 (5.5 = dimension C, lead pitch); y centres +-(1.3/2 + 1.9/2) = +-1.6; y edges +-0.65..+-2.55.

footprints.description: Suntsu SXT834 4-pad SMD crystal, 8.0 x 3.8 mm, pads 1.3 x 1.9 on a 5.5 x 3.2 rectangle
footprints.note: Suntsu SXT834-Series.pdf p.2 Outline Drawing & Recommended Land Pattern (drawn portrait): along the length pad 1.3 | gap 4.2 | pad 1.3, across the body pad 1.9 | gap 1.3 | pad 1.9 (same pad geometry as XTAL-SOJ-5.5-4-ABRACON). Numbering from the ELECTRODE ARRANGEMENT (BOTTOM VIEW): 1 TL, 4 TR, 2 BL, 3 BR; mirrored to the top view and turned 90 deg counter-clockwise: 1 top left, 2 top right, 3 bottom right, 4 bottom left (clockwise numbering, so it cannot share the Abracon / ECS id). Hand check: x +-(4.2/2 + 1.3/2) = +-2.75; y +-(1.3/2 + 1.9/2) = +-1.6.
